knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

#Load NRI
nri <- read.csv("nri_county_trimmed.csv",
  colClasses = c("STCOFIPS" = "character"), #guarantee is a character
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  na.strings = c("", " ", "NA")
)

head(nri, 5)


glimpse(nri)
unique(nchar(nri$STCOFIPS))

#
table(nchar(nri$STCOFIPS))

# fix if needed
nri <- nri %>%
  mutate(STCOFIPS = str_pad(STCOFIPS, width = 5, side = "left", pad = "0"))

# cleaning
nri <- nri %>%
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("EAL_"), as.numeric),
    across(
      ends_with("EALB") | ends_with("EALP") |
        ends_with("EALPE") | ends_with("EALT"),
      as.numeric
    ),
    SOVI_SCORE = as.numeric(SOVI_SCORE),
    SOVI_RATNG = as.factor(SOVI_RATNG)
  )

summary(nri)
head(nri, 10)

```
